name: list_all_students
description: List all students who have learning progress data, optionally filtered by a specific agent/course. Returns each student's user ID, agent, completion percentage, topic counts (learned / in_progress / not_started), and last active time.

agent_id.description: Optional. Filter to a specific agent/course name (e.g. 'course-Machine-Learning'). If omitted, returns students across all agents.
